cover.concept: A neat, perfectly aligned grid of identical pale square tiles on a calm field, still and catalog-like; at one point the grid opens and a single soft, irregular warm-orange organic shape sits in the gap, sending gentle ripples outward across the surrounding tiles.

inline.name: still-catalog
inline.concept: Two bands on a pale field: above, a row of identical polished deep-indigo squares, evenly spaced and motionless like a display shelf; below, a single loose, hand-drawn-feeling warm orange curve that moves unevenly across the whole frame, alive and in motion.

inline.name: share-ripple
inline.concept: A small warm orange dot at the center of a calm pale field sending out soft concentric rings that travel far beyond its first circle, reaching and gently lighting up a few scattered muted-indigo dots near the edges.
